name: Hotel Brunelleschi
positioning: Hotel built around the Torre della Pagliazza, an ancient round tower on Piazza Sant'Elisabetta, steps from the Duomo in Florence's historic center
best_for: History lovers who want to sleep inside an ancient tower and explore a private archaeological museum
Travelers who want a central Florence base steps from the Duomo

facts.text: The hotel incorporates the Torre della Pagliazza, a tower whose origins are placed between the sixth and seventh centuries.
The hotel is on Piazza Sant'Elisabetta, steps from the Duomo.
The tower is widely regarded as the oldest building still standing in Florence's historic center.
The unusually circular tower rests on Roman foundations, including a circular wall linked to a thermal structure of ancient Florentia.
The tower was cited in 1268 as a prison, and in 1285 specifically as a women's prison.
The tower was later reused as the bell tower of the nearby church of San Michele alle Trombe, later Sant'Elisabetta.
Rooms and suites pair contemporary Italian design with the character of the historic building.
Interiors use Florentine materials such as leather and velvet.
Suites feature original architectural elements such as exposed brick arches and marble.
The hotel offers family solutions and connecting rooms.
Breakfast is served in what was once a medieval church, or can be taken in the room.
Osteria della Pagliazza serves fresh pasta, seasonal cooking and Tuscan classics.

highlights.text: Two rooms are inside the ancient tower itself: the Deluxe Tower Room and the Pagliazza Tower Suite.
The hotel's private museum lets guests see the Roman calidarium uncovered during excavations, with Roman, medieval and Renaissance artefacts.
Some suites have views over Florence's rooftops.
Suites include a butler and porter.
The Tower Bar serves cocktails inside the round stone of the ancient tower.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes the historic building may mean smaller room sizes.
The small archaeological display at the base of the tower is visitable on request.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing for the central Florence location.
